title: successful behavior: a critical authorized swarm warning reaches local and remote subscribers once per policy
fixture: tests/fixtures/swarm_v2/fleet-broadcasts.json: local seat eng-1@fixture and remote seat eng-2@fixture on channels brain and amygdala; operator critical warning (until_ack, ttl 600 s), expired warning (ttl 30 s), personal brain message and an agent info note (once); published at 1000 ms, claimed at 61000 ms
fixture_clock: build() from tests/sv2_ctl02_cases.py patches time.time to the fixture clock and issues launch grants; FleetBroadcasts reads the same list; fakeredis server clock only in test_the_default_clock_is_the_redis_server_clock

state_assertions.delivery: The local seat (store client of the controller) and the remote seat (a separate RedisStore client) each claim agent-note and fleet-warning at 61000 ms; the expired warning and the personal brain message are not delivered
state_assertions.policy: A second claim returns only the until_ack warning, keeping the first delivery time; the once note is not replayed; after acknowledgement claims return nothing
state_assertions.acknowledgement: The first acknowledgement of revision 1 returns true, the duplicate returns false and broadcast-duplicate-acks counts 1 per seat
state_assertions.store: broadcast-deliveries for the local seat records revision 1, delivered 61000 ms, acked, the grant's execution id and generation 1; history lists the four published revisions in order
state_assertions.authority: The operator warning carries author operator:operator and the swarm fleet; the agent note's author is the seat and execution id from its validated launch grant
state_assertions.local_cache: Claimed revisions land in the broadcast file in the hook format, tagged fleet, and hook injection shows them only to the session that claimed them; sync_local writes nothing unless AGENTIHOOKS_FLEET_BROADCASTS=1

boundary: The Redis records under the swarm root are the authoritative broadcasts and delivery state; the local broadcast file is a per-session compatibility cache
cleanup: fakeredis and tmp_path per test; no live resource mutations

broadcast_delivery_lag_seconds.dimension: seat eng-1@fixture and eng-2@fixture, broadcast fleet-warning revision 1, published 1000 ms, delivered 61000 ms
